To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the flower type NiCo(2)O(4) coated 3D GNF shows high reversible lithium storage capacity, superior cyclability and rate performance, which are superior compared to the sheet type.
the morphology of NiCo2O 4 can be tuned by electrodeposition potential or current variation and that the binder free NiCO2O4/ 3D GNF electrode demonstrates excellent lithium storage performance.

the flower type NiCo 2O4 demonstrates a high reversible discharge capacity and excellent cyclability, which are superior than that of sheet type NiCo 1O 4, which can be ascribed to the high volume utilization efficiency, well preserved connection between active materials and current collector, short lithium ion diffusion pathway and fast electrolyte transport in binder free NiCo 2 O 4 coated 3 D graphene structure.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of novel binder free electrode materials for lithium ion batteries, which are prepared via simple electrodeposition and annealing process, which are used in lithium ion batteries for the first time.
the synthesis of NiCo2O 4 coated 3 D graphene architecture and their use as binder free electrode for lithium ion batteries.
the synthesis of binder free nickel cobaltite/graphene composites with tunable flower or sheet morphology by a facile electrodeposited method.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the flower type NiCo 2O4 coated three dimensional graphene architectures are a potential candidate for lithium ion batteries.
the binder free Ni-Co-O/3D G NF hybrid is a promising anode material for lithium ion batteries.
the flower type NiCo 2O4 coated on 3D GNF is an excellent anode material for lithium ion batteries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a simple, facile, low cost and efficient electrodeposition method has been proposed to fabricate binder free 3D graphene/NiCo2O4 composite electrodes with different morphologies for lithium ion batteries.
the binder free electrode structure is a promising candidate for lithium ion battery electrodes.
the binder free 3D graphene architecture is a promising candidate for the construction of high performance lithium ion battery anode materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the morphology of electrode materials is a critical factor for their performance in lithium ion batteries.
the flower type NiCo(2)O(4) coated 3D GNF is a potential binder free anode material for lithium ion batteries.

the flower type NiCo 2O 4 coated 3 DGNF hybrid is a promising binder-free lithium ion battery anode material with high capacity and excellent cyclability, which is attributed to its unique binder free electrode structure, which is tunable and easily prepared by a simple and scalable process.
